findings.message: CSS declaration `transition: transform 0.2s ease` runs on the browser clock and cannot be seeked deterministically across render workers.
findings.fixHint: Keep the class or attribute swap for state; put the visual change on the paused GSAP timeline.

findings.message: <audio data-start="0"> has no id, so Studio cannot use a stable edit target for its timeline and canvas controls.
findings.fixHint: Add a stable, human-readable id such as id="hero-title" or id="scene-1-card" to every timeline-visible element you want agents or Studio to edit.

findings.message: <audio> has data-start but no id attribute. The renderer requires id to discover media elements, so this audio will be SILENT in renders.
findings.fixHint: Add a unique id attribute: <audio id="my-audio" ...>

findings.message: Track 0 has 5 timed elements in this HTML file. Smaller sub-compositions keep timelines easier to read, iterate on, and diff.
findings.fixHint: Move coherent scene groups into separate .html files under compositions/ and mount them from the parent with data-composition-src so the timeline stays easier to inspect, revise, and validate.

findings.message: Font family used without @font-face declaration: sfmono-regular. These are not in the auto-resolved font list, so the renderer cannot supply them automatically. Text will fall back to a generic font, producing incorrect typography in the video.
findings.fixHint: Add @font-face { font-family: '...'; src: url('capture/assets/fonts/...woff2'); } for each font family, pointing to the captured .woff2 files. For an OS-bundled system font (e.g. Hiragino Sans, Microsoft YaHei) that has no downloadable file, use src: local('Exact Font Name') instead. The declaration alone satisfies this check without needing a font file.

findings.message: <div id="scene-1"> is a timeline element that contains nested <div>. The timeline shows one row per top-level element, and the root composition is built only from sub-compositions.
findings.fixHint: Move <div id="scene-1"> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.
